Theme: Personality and Autonomic Responses to Stress
Description: Investigated associations between facets of Neuroticism, Extraversion and Openness to Experience and HRV under baseline and experimentally induced stress conditions in young adults.
KeyMetrics: HRV; Big Five Aspects Scale (BFAS); Arithmetic Drill; Expected-Speech Stress Task

Description: Compared conventional Nature-Guided Imagery (NGI) with Virtual Reality-assisted NGI (VR-NGI) for inducing relaxation among university students using physiological and subjective measures.
KeyMetrics: GSR; Virtual Reality (VR); Nature-Guided Imagery; Subjective Relaxation Assessment

Description: Investigating scalp electrical oscillations and event-related potentials (P300, N200) to decode decision-making, cognitive-emotional conflict, and memory processes.
Developing self-regulation training protocols utilizing continuous heart rate variability (HRV), blood volume pulse, respiration patterns, and electrodermal feedback.
KeyMetrics: RMSSD, High-Frequency Power (HF-HRV), Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA), Skin Conductance
